ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT. Contains measurement-only tail, Pawn/Job/Wait, GenClosest/Reachability, Map/World/Storyteller timing, Harmony patch census and reflective RimMT status reporting. Disable this mod for normal gameplay when diagnostics are not needed.
